title: [Master] - Bug 645038 Withholding Tax entries from a previous posting preview appear on unrelated documents (e.g. expense report)
summary: Withholding Tax entries from a previous posting preview no longer leak into unrelated document previews. The fix clears temporary WHT entries at the start of each preview instead of only during actual posting.
key_points: Fixed bug where stale Withholding Tax entries from one preview appeared when previewing an unrelated document
Root cause was that temporary entries were only cleared on actual posting, not on preview operations
Solution clears the temporary Withholding Tax buffer at the start of every preview operation
Removed subscribers from OnBeforePostPurchaseDoc and OnBeforeGenJnlDoc events
Cleaned up unused imports after refactoring
quote: temporary Withholding Tax entries were only cleared from subscribers tied to actual posting
